data.narrative:
ParityQC is a Series A quantum computing company founded by Wolfgang Lechner and Magdalena Hauser. The valuation universe comprises 11 peers across quantum computing: 3 public companies (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private firms including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

Standard peer-median methodology is not applicable here. The quantum computing cohort lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables—zero Series A peers with comparable valuations or operational maturity exist in the data set. An all-sector median would conflate vastly different capital deployment, technology readiness, and commercialization timelines across the broader quantum ecosystem, introducing material bias. The sparse, heterogeneous peer set precludes reliable triangulation via multiples.

Without sufficient peer density at comparable stages, a defensible valuation range cannot be derived from the data provided. ParityQC's Series A valuation would depend on bottom-up drivers (technology differentiation, patent portfolio, customer pipeline, burn profile, capital efficiency relative to peers) and top-down benchmarking against the broader 11-firm universe, though the latter carries high uncertainty. Narrower stage-specific comps or disclosed transaction data from recent Series A rounds in quantum computing would be required to establish a quantitatively grounded range.
